content:
incident-bot: Pager — Dedicated pool 'sierra-enterprise-1' GPU allocation at 97% and sustained for 6m. Top consumer: tenant 'SierraHealth' (vpc-sierra-01). Possible customer impact: degraded p99 latency, queueing.
oncall-jordan: Acked. I'm on it. @sre-lee handing over.
sre-lee: Joining. Can someone post the current pool utilization table?
ops-kate: Pasting snapshot from metrics API:
```
pool: sierra-enterprise-1
total_gpus: 8
allocated: 7.8
free: 0.2
top_tenant: SierraHealth (6.9 gpus)
queued_requests: 230
avg_p99_latency: 1.9s -> 4.3s over last 5m
```
eng-runtime-raj: Looks like their tenant pinned a heavy model variant with long context lengths. We can do three quick mitigations: 1) temporary burst override (if contract allows) to shared capacity, 2) spin extra nodes into Dedicated (takes ~8-12m), 3) trigger automatic degradation to q4_1 or reduce max_tokens at router layer.
customer-success-maya: Pinged SierraHealth via email and a support call — they're seeing timeouts on internal editor tools. They want ETA for restoration.
sales-ethan: Customer has a burst quota for emergencies of 2 GPUs for up to 2 hours per contract, but needs approval for billing beyond that.
oncall-jordan: @infra-luis can you check if shared pool has spare capacity and what's the latency hit if we route some traffic there?
infra-luis: Checking now. Shared pools in us-west-2 have ~3 free gpus but those are running mixed low-priority jobs. Latency to them for this model variant measured ~2.4x of dedicated baseline during tests.
eng-olivia: If we migrate all large requests, we'd risk quality regressions for SierraHealth. Prefer partial routing: drop long-context requests to shared + keep short requests local.
sre-lee: Agree. Immediate plan: A) apply targeted routing rule for tenant SierraHealth to route requests with prompt_tokens > 4096 to shared pool, B) open burst override for +1 GPU from shared for 30m while autoscaler spins new nodes, C) throttle max_concurrent_requests for their router to 10 to reduce queueing. Anyone object?
sales-ethan: Approve burst override under emergency clause. I'll log approval in the ticket.
ops-kate: Implementing routing rule now. Pushing config:
```
route_override:
  tenant: sierrahealth
  condition: prompt_tokens > 4096
  action: route_to: shared-usw2-priority-low
  preserve_kv_cache: false
```
eng-runtime-raj: Throttling and burst override applied. Autoscaler triggered new instance pool request. ETA for additional nodes ~9 minutes.
oncall-jordan: Observability — watch p99 and queued_requests. Also post a short message to #incidents-status for exec visibility.
ops-kate: Metrics update after changes (2m): queued_requests down 40%, p99 from 4.3s -> 2.1s. Shared pool latency spike observed but within acceptable range for degraded requests.
customer-success-maya: Letting SierraHealth know we've routed long-context jobs to fallback hardware and expect recovery in ~10-12m. Keeping them on the line for updates.
eng-olivia: We should also enable an auto-fallback in routing to switch to smaller model variant when tokens > 6k; add as follow-up for next hour.
sre-lee: Agreed for post-incident. For now, monitor and prepare rollback if latency for their short requests increases.
infra-luis: New Dedicated node provisioning status: instance request accepted, 3/4 gpus initializing, will be joinable in ~7m.
ops-kate: 7m update: new nodes joined, pool capacity +2.6 GPUs effective. I've lowered their throttle to 15.
oncall-jordan: Good. p99 back to 1.1s for local routes. Queue cleared. Closing active mitigation, leaving burst override open for 30 more minutes then auto-revoke.
sales-ethan: Noted. I'll follow up re: billing per contract for emergency burst. CS to confirm customer satisfaction.
customer-success-maya: SierraHealth confirmed service restored for editors. They requested a postmortem and action items to avoid recurrence.
sre-lee: Will own postmortem. Action items: 1) add tenant-level autoscale thresholds + alerts for >80% sustained usage, 2) implement model-fallback policy for long-context requests, 3) review burst billing automation.
oncall-jordan: Thanks team. I'll hand the page back to rotation. Incident classified as Sev-2 (customer-impact, mitigated).
incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) — duration 32m. Reminder: postmortem due in 48h.
